cites.stt: Speech Is 3x Faster Than Typing for English and Mandarin on Mobile Devices
cites.x: You can - if 150 wpm is what you speak, with Plover and training you can reach 120-225 wpm on a qwerty keyboard with NKRO capability. But it's indeed steno (on a regular keyboard).

cites.stt: Ask HN: How did you keep improving your typing speed after 100 WPM?
cites.x: Court reporters are required to type at 240WPM with zero mistakes, or they lose their court reporting license. You can teach yourself to use a stenography machine.
